item.title: Fundraisers set up to help families of teens killed in Lorain marina crash
item.description: After two teenage girls lost their lives in a crash at a Lorain marina early Friday morning, multiple fundraisers have been set up to help their families.

item.title: Teens charged in NYC bomb attempt wanted to surpass Boston Marathon terror attack, prosecutors say
item.description: Two ISIS-inspired men accused of trying to detonate bombs at New York City protests wanted to cause a terror attack bigger than the Boston Marathon, according to federal prosecutors.

item.title: James Harden scores 21, joins 29,000-point club in Cavaliers' 115-101 win
item.description: James Harden scored 21 points to become the ninth player in NBA history with more than 29,000 career points, Keon Ellis added 19 off the bench, and the Cleveland Cavaliers cruised to a 115-101 victory over the short-handed Philadelphia 76ers on Monday night.

item.title: Magistrate rules against using unclaimed funds to build Ohio sports stadiums: I-Team
item.description: The FOX 8 I-Team has learned a magistrate has ruled against using unclaimed funds to help build sports stadiums.

item.title: Woman killed in 4-vehicle crash in Huron County: OSHP
item.description: The Ohio State Highway Patrol is investigating after a deadly crash in Huron County on Monday afternoon.

item.title: Browns signing LB Quincy Williams: Reports
item.description: The Cleveland Browns have signed former New York Jets linebacker Quincy Williams, according to reports.

item.title: New video tied to murder of Lyft driver: I-Team
item.description: Video released to the FOX 8 I-Team shows part of what investigators are going over as they continue to investigate the murders of two Lyft drivers and the assault of a third.

item.title: Big changes this week: Tracking storms, falling temps and possible snow
item.description: Tomorrow afternoon will still be mild as temperatures climb into the upper 60s. A bit more cloud coverage through the day with a few sprinkles. Most of the day will remain quiet.

item.title: I-Team: New records revealed after young girls buried in suitcases
item.description: The FOX 8 I-Team has found a Cleveland mother is not the only person being investigated for the murder of two of her children found buried in suitcases.

item.title: Local sheriff's deputy, dispatcher help save resident's life during severe allergic reaction
item.description: An alert dispatcher and a quick-acting sheriff's deputy are being credited with helping save the life of a 911 caller who was suffering from a severe allergic reaction.
